segments.snp5.13:1.4: Kappañjahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.
segments.snp5.13:2.1: “Nānājanā janapadehi saṅgatā, tava vīra vākyaṃ abhikaṅkhamānā;
segments.snp5.13:2.3: Tesaṃ tuvaṃ sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo”.
segments.snp5.13:3.4: Yaṃ yañhi lokasmimupādiyanti, teneva māro anveti jantuṃ.
segments.snp5.13:4.1: “Tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke;
segments.snp5.13:4.3: Ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan”ti.

lines: Ekā eva hi taṇhā thutivasena idha nānappakārato vuttā.
Sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti itoti nāgassa tava bhagavā vacanaṃ sutvā ito pāsāṇakacetiyato bahū janā pakkamissantīti adhippāyo.
